newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Bank Central Asia closes US$150 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: PT Bank Central Asia closes US$150 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Central Asia's US$150 million negotiable floating rate certificates of deposit issue through its Nassau Branch has been oversubscribed and commitments are scaled back, said arranger LTCB Asia.
The six-year certificates were issued at par to float at 62.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There is a put and call option in year three.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 74 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$8 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia, Commerzbank (South East Asia), LTCB Asia, Sakura Merchant Bank (Singapore) and Sanwa International Finance.

Co-arrangers are Banca Commerciale Italiana's Singapore Branch, Daiwa Securities (HK), Indover Bank and NatWest Markets, with US$8 million each, and NORD/LB Singapore Branch and Yasuda Trust's Singapore Branch, with US$7 million each.

Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Bank of New York's Hong Kong Branch, Banque Nationale de Paris's Singapore Branch, Barclays Bank, Berliner Bank, Chinatrust Commercial Bank, Gulf International Bank and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp.

Senior managers are Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino SpA's Singapore Branch and Thai Farmers Bank's Singapore Branch, with US$4 million each, First Commercial Bank, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale, Mitsubishi Trust Finance (Asia), National Bank of Abu Dhabi and Tat Lee Bank, with US$3 million each, and Baden-Wurttembergische Bank, Banca di Roma SpA's Hong Kong Branch and Taiwan Cooperative Bank's Offshore Banking Branch, with US$2 million each.
